BiblicalUsage: Before any rain fell, a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground, and Job says God draws up the drops of water that distil as rain from His mist. The word is small and quiet, just vapour rising, yet it watered Eden.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God waters His world gently before He ever sends the storm, and His quiet provision comes first.
